title: The Case of the Suspicion Machine
slogan: AI NEWS · HUMAN-CENTRED · HUMANS IN CONTROL
music: 1930s art deco film-noir jazz: smoky muted trumpet, walking upright bass, brushed snare, soft big-band brass swells, elegant and mysterious, minor key, no vocals.
ambience: Night city in light rain, distant elevated train rumble, far traffic, no music.

shots.say: Case six. A city let a machine decide whom to suspect. Two newsrooms opened it up.

sfx.prompt: Distant elevated train rumbling over steel tracks at night in the rain

shots.say: Rotterdam, the Netherlands. From twenty seventeen to twenty twenty-one, the city scored people on welfare with an algorithm. The top ten percent were investigated for fraud.

ov.sub: people on welfare, ranked by a risk score

sfx.prompt: Vintage typewriter typing a short line with a carriage bell

shots.say: The model weighed three hundred and fifteen inputs: age, gender, language skills, neighbourhood, even a caseworker's impressions. Out came a score from zero to one.

sfx.prompt: Old mechanical gauge needle ticking and creaking as it rises, then a soft click

shots.say: Reporters at Lighthouse Reports and WIRED did something rare. Through freedom of information requests, they obtained the model itself, and tested it from the inside.

sfx.prompt: Heavy brass revolving door turning in a quiet marble lobby, footsteps echo

shots.say: They found it treated people differently by ethnicity and gender, with flaws that made it both inaccurate and unfair. The city had already paused it, and later dropped plans for a new one.

ov.sub: findings of the Lighthouse Reports investigation

sfx.prompt: Brass balance scale creaking and settling, a soft metallic clink

shots.say: A machine can sort people. Only people can be held to account for it. And sometimes it takes a reporter to open the box. Case closed.

sfx.prompt: Elevated train passing overhead with rhythmic clatter, fading away
Single heavy rubber stamp thud on paper on a wooden desk
